result.title: TRACE: Trajectory Synchronization for Training-Free Resolution Extension in Video Generation
result.summary: More text-to-video models are available, but many remain limited to low resolutions. Training them for higher resolutions is costly, while existing training-free methods still struggle with fine detail, scene structure, and efficiency. We propose TRACE, a training-free method that synchronizes low- and high-resolution generation trajectories. During early denoising, TRACE aligns predicted scene content at corresponding noise levels. It computes high-resolution updates from low-resolution predictions and the current high-resolution state, without high-resolution model inference. The high-resolution trajectory retains fine-grained variation for generating new details. Local window attention then refines fine details in a shared high-resolution latent state. TRACE checks suspected duplicate subjects against the corresponding low-resolution layout and corrects selected regions and their solver history while preserving detail elsewhere. Experiments across all kinds of video generation backbones and resolutions show improved perceptual quality and text-video alignment over FreeSwim, a state-of-the-art training-free method, with 2.0-2.9x end-to-end speedups. Our code and models will be released at https://github.com/libozhu03/TRACE.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的视频生成分辨率扩展方法 TRACE：同步低分辨率与高分辨率的去噪轨迹，用低分预测与当前高分状态计算高分更新而无需高分模型推理，再以局部窗口注意力细化细节，并核查疑似重复主体、校正选定区域及其求解器历史。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨轨迹 latent 状态对齐、重复内容核查与局部状态校正，可能为 diffusion 式 latent 推理中的状态更新、视觉细节保持与证据筛选提供可供核查的技术线索；但论文面向视频生成质量，未涉及推理过程或答案对 latent 的使用。
